digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI and tracker sync infrastructure
propositions: A provider-neutral Python-first bridge surface replaces fragmented Jira-specific operations with canonical verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume) under rebar bridge while retaining historical contracts.

Argument-less reconcile preserves dry-run behavior; argument-less bridge sync is the canonical mutating command; legacy bridge-status and exit codes 3, 4, 75 remain compatible through explicit adapters.
The shared Python core service exposes bridge operations through three equal interfaces: CLI (rebar bridge), Python library, and MCP server, with no private reimplementations.
Bridge operation succeeds across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments via runner-neutral provider wrappers sharing code-derived exit behavior and secrets vocabulary.
Python-owned tickets-branch delivery via src/rebar/_store/push.py eliminates workflow-local CAS retry loops and requires no gh CLI dependency for destructive repair.
Pause state is durable, mixed-version safe, includes reason, and works with brew, pip, and MCP-server installation paths; ADR 0092 is uniquely numbered and indexed in docs/adr/README.md.
